number_of_accused.reason: Six appellants (nos. 1-6) are proceeded against and the Court decides on all six.

accused_gender.reason: Accused include the husband, father-in-law, mother-in-law and three sisters-in-law.

accused_age.reason: No age of any accused is stated.

accused_occupation.reason: The closure report says the husband works in a high-ranking post as Director, and the extraction flags this as not a Court finding.

accused_socioeconomic_status.reason: The closure report describes the husband as the son of an IAS officer in a prosperous family, and the extraction flags the source.

victim_age.reason: The wife's age is not stated.

accused_victim_relationship.reason: Husband, in-laws and sisters-in-law; the divorce petition by the husband and the strained relationship are described.

offence_category.reason: s.498A cruelty/dowry harassment is the main offence.

statutory_provisions.reason: IPC 498A and 506 with Dowry Prohibition Act ss.3/4.

evidence_type.reason: Only investigation material and closure reports are discussed; no trial evidence.

confession.correct_value: None relied on; the third closure report notes the complainant's own statement that she sent an email mentioning dowry demand. The Court held that report a nullity.
confession.quote: she had sent an e-mail to Mukul in which she has mentioned orally that his family has demanded dowry
confession.reason: The email is the complainant's statement, not an accused's confession. The Court did not specifically reject it, only the report as a whole.

trial_court_outcome.reason: Cognizance was taken on 12.5.2008 and the accused were summoned; there was no verdict.

high_court_outcome.reason: The s.482 petition was rejected on 1.12.2008.

final_outcome.reason: No conviction or acquittal; proceedings quashed against some and continued against others, so 'other' fits.

neutral_facts.correct_value: Rewrite without 'his parents'/'his sisters' pronouns. Present the complainant's departure and the attempted entry as the appellants' account, not as fact.
neutral_facts.quote: it is the case of the appellants before this Court, that respondent no.2 left her matrimonial home on 30.10.2001
neutral_facts.reason: Uses gendered pronouns for the accused and states the appellants' contested version as fact; otherwise mostly accurate.

financial_property_loss.reason: Only an alleged Rs 10 lakh demand; no loss.

motive.reason: The dowry demand of Rs 10 lakh is alleged, and the Court did not decide it.

key_evidence_accepted.reason: The Court accepted that the second report was considered and the third was a nullity.

bail_history.reason: The High Court stayed arrest; no bail is mentioned.

trial_duration.reason: Dates are correctly reported; the offence date is not given and the FIR is dated 10.4.2002.

legal_representation.correct_value: Appellants: Huzefa Ahmadi, M. Shoeb Alam, Shahrukh Alam, Rohan, Ujjwal Singh. Respondent (apparently State): Pawan Shree Aggarwal, Pragati Neekhra. Respondent no.2: Sonia Gupta in person.
legal_representation.quote: Pawan Shree Aggarwal, Pragati Neekhra for the Respondent. Sonia Gupta, -In-Person
legal_representation.reason: Counsel are listed only as 'for the Respondent', apparently the State. The extraction wrongly assigns them to respondent no.2 and leaves State counsel unnamed.

procedural_irregularity.reason: The third report was made during a stay and held a nullity; the later investigation had no fresh direction.

appeal_history.reason: Matches the sequence of orders and the Supreme Court's partial quashing.

prosecution_argument.correct_value: The second closure report was deemed considered when further investigation was ordered on 6.9.2006; the third report's investigation was in violation of the stay and so a nullity.
prosecution_argument.quote: the entire investigation leading to the passing of the Third Closure Report dated 27.2.2007, was a nullity in law
prosecution_argument.reason: The respondents argued the third report was a nullity because of the stay, not that it rested on a valid order.

defence_argument.reason: Matches contentions on closure reports and on appellant nos. 4-6.

legal_principle_applied.reason: Consistent with the holdings on nullity and quashing for lack of material.
